adversarial_acceptance.reporting: Publish per-stage denominators: routed correctly, discovered true places, confirmed/marked correctly, masks usable, final paint correct, spec correct, Undo correct. Necessary clarification is safe workflow progress but not a completed paint. Do not exclude empty/absent targets or failed loads from the denominator silently.
adversarial_acceptance.quality: Measure target coverage and leakage as well as IoU. Grade sponsor lettering versus whole decal according to the request. For keep-colors/spec-only changes compare paint bytes and each spec channel; color appearance alone cannot certify matte/chrome. Preserve baseline renders and actual final outputs.
adversarial_acceptance.freshness: Known16/30 self-help and repaired28-case scope sets are regression/development evidence. A fresh set remains independent only until its answers influence tuning. Subsequent reruns must be relabeled regression. Run baseline/final under equivalent loading and masking conditions; do not page-side patch revisions or visibility.

architecture_constraints: AI helpers plan and call existing controllers; they do not own new pixel, Zone, routing or Undo authority.
Zone code owns masks/material assignments; Layer code owns active layer pixels/transform. An AI promise about a layer does not authorize a whole-body material edit.
Capture document identity before asynchronous work; verify immediately before publication and during deferred continuations.
Prefer bounded pure modules and focused tests to adding more code to spb-pro-ai.js/self-help generated arrays or canvas/state monsters.
Do not widen synonyms until tag/reference precision is curated. Do not regenerate production cards from backups or overwrite manual/deep/unknown fields.
No paid-provider certification can be inferred from offline/in-page tools or the private live ChatGPT MCP. Keep installed build, real MCP, in-page mocks and paid tiers separate in evidence.

offline_capability_ideas: Explain my last change: receipt-derived target, paint retained/recolored, spec change, unresolved part and one supported Undo action.
Make it more/less: bound follow-up to the last successful current-document target; a recommendation or undone action supplies no mutable context.
Check my setup: prioritize live observed findings, then one actionable mode-aware manual step; no mutation from diagnosis.
Show me the target: current selection overlay with fill/outline, logo/lettering and stripe-color options; reject/none is first-class.
Learn this car: teach real geometry once as car-layout evidence while keeping each paint's artwork placements as proposals.
Recover what I meant: preserve the failed request and offer two supported interpretations with exact scope, rather than broad fallback suggestions.
limits: Static bounded review only. No new model/visual quality score or confirmed lifecycle failure. The parent owns Wiki logging/lane release and live integration.
